description: This file defines the ListViewSearchController class within the Api\V8\Controller namespace. It handles list view search-related requests and depends on ListViewSearchService and ListViewSearchParams. The class contains a constructor for dependency injection and a method getModuleSearchDefs that processes search definition requests, returning a JSON response or an error.
